I can’t imagine my life without Google Calendar. Unfortunely, since (I guess) two weeks ago some lags occured. I start the app and its laggy. When I want to drag to next week preview it does not react immediately and sometimes it skips to next week of same month but different year. Even through some actualizations this problem still presists.
If anyone has same problem, you can contact me about ways how to fix it (could be problem in 4 shared calendars? Is it too much for the app?)
I am using iPhone 6s.
